name: Phenibut
effects: Severe protracted withdrawal; dependence develops within 2-3 weeks of daily use. AVOID frequent dosing.
GABA-B agonist with alpha-2-delta affinity (similar to gabapentin)
Tolerance builds rapidly — limit to 1-2x per week maximum

halfLifeEvidence.quote: the elimination half-life was approximately 5.3 hours
